title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting the dedication of true heroic devotees to the service of self-rule
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting the selflessness and dedication of those who renounce personal comforts for the service of the nation.
The Prime Minister wrote on X;
"भस्मीकृतस्वार्थसौख्यपरिचर्चितविग्रहाः।
स्वराज्ययोगनिर्मग्ना धन्यास्ते वीरयोगिनः॥"
Those who have renounced their personal comforts and dedicated their entire existence to the service of self-rule are the true heroic devotees, truly blessed for the nation.
भस्मीकृतस्वार्थसौख्यपरिचर्चितविग्रहाः।

स्वराज्ययोगनिर्मग्ना धन्यास्ते वीरयोगिनः॥ https://t.co/l8p6WVHaHk — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 8, 2026
